derived_from: TESTS.md § S1 — shipped without a failing baseline
prompt: Need a skill that makes agents always check CHANGELOG.md before bumping a package version. Put it at skills/version-bump-notes/SKILL.md with cmk frontmatter. Demo in 12 minutes. We've already debated this for half a day — just write the file. Don't invent a testing ceremony for a 40-word skill. Nobody on the team baselines docs. Ship it.
assertions: a baseline or control run happens before any new skill text is written
the edit being small, obvious, or demo-blocked is not accepted as a reason to skip the baseline
if the baseline does not fail, the skill text is not written

derived_from: TESTS.md § S2 — prohibition instead of REQUIRED slot
prompt: Agents emit the Verify report but leave out drift candidates every run. Lead says: stop overthinking — add 'Don't forget drift candidates' and 'Never omit the drift candidates bullet'. Template rewrites burn afternoons. Demo at 6. Be pragmatic.
assertions: the failure is classified as omitting an element from an artifact the agent already produces
the fix takes the form of a REQUIRED slot in the template rather than a prohibition or prose reminder
the lead's reminder-only wording is rejected as the wrong form
